thread:
kai: Heads-up: proposing to lift the runtime pin for 'orchid' models (runtime 3.0.2 -> 3.1.0) in the 04:00-05:00 UTC change window. This includes the new delayed-kv allocator and auth handshake alignment. Need perf + security signoff.
lorna: any known incompat with quantized-2 models? Last time allocator change affected memory accounting.
kai: good catch. We're scoping the rollout to non-quantized models first, canary only. Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual go at 25%. Rollback triggers: error_rate>2% sustained 5m OR p95_delta>250ms.
devon: add gating on canary nodes not being on mixed-driver topology; we've seen allocator issues there.
kai: gating added: "infra/topology!=mixed-driver". Also adding perf-bot preflight that runs 30m long-seq samples.
deploybot: Schedule set for 04:00 UTC. Automated rollback conditions configured. Will log each stage.
perf-bot: queued preflight at 03:25 for 30m. Will report PASS/FAIL.
security: quick note: handshake alignment includes token header name change. Ensure clients with custom proxies are accounted for; we'll run a proxy smoke.
kai: added proxy smoke to preflight. If proxy check fails, abort.
perf-bot: PRELIGHT PASS at 03:56 UTC. Samples show ~6% p95 improvement on canary subset.
devon: mobile infra reported no mixed-driver placements in the target cohort. Gates clear.
kai: proceeding with canary at 04:00. keep eyes on mem/cpu per node.
deploybot: Canary started 04:02 -> 5% routing. Initial metrics: latency down 6%, errors flat. Advancing to 25% at 04:10.
lorna: note: small steady p95 rise in ap-northeast after 25% bump (+120ms). Not past threshold but correlated with a single allocator path in traces.
kai: hold at 25%. devon, can you triage quick?
devon: looking now. early traces show increased GC-like stalls on that allocator path; might be driver interaction.
lona: (typo) sorry lorna meant to say 'I'm seeing'.
lo rna: (fix) seeing the spike only on older GPU drivers.
kai: decision: abort final ramp. No automatic rollback yet since thresholds not breached, but we'll pin back in 10m if signs worsen. For safety, mark this attempt as "partial hold - topology probe failed" in release notes.
deploybot: Holding at 25% per request. No rollback executed.
perf-bot: scheduling deeper trace capture and creating ticket #1007 for allocator-driver mismatch.
security: we've seen no handshake failures in proxy smoke. OK on that front.
devon: opening issue #1007 and attaching traces. Recommending driver probe + allocator flag toggle for the next attempt.
kai: updating release notes: "orchid runtime unpin attempt held at canary due to allocator-driver trace; no customer impact; retry planned with extra driver checks." Closing thread; follow-ups in #release-notes and issue #1007. Thanks all.
